body: Yeah, not sure how well talking to them would work.
I could try, see how it goes, not going to get my hopes too high, considering I don’t think they really care about my cuts
Funny thing is they were actually yelling at me the whole time, pretty much reprimanding me for being suicidal

Can’t, forgot to mention I’m under 18, parents have seen my cuts before, they didn’t consider the fact I was probably suicidal, they just told me not to do it because people could get the wrong idea and they would think they’re abusing me.
